Connecting Kiro to an External Tool via MCP

Connecting a new tool to Kiro takes minutes, not hours.
Add an MCP server config pointing at the tool you want.
Kiro's agents can now call that tool directly during a task.
No custom integration code required on your end.

Episode 57 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
